parsed.faithful: The conferve of mint retains the taste and virtues of the herb. It is given in weaknesses of the stomach and retchings to vomit; and not unfrequently does service in some cases of this kind, where the warmer and more active preparations of mint would be less proper.
parsed.modern: The conserve of mint retains the taste and virtues of the herb. It is given in weaknesses of the stomach and retchings to vomit; and not unfrequently does service in some cases of this kind, where the warmer and more active preparations of mint would be less proper.
